matchup.title: Matchup 3: Come-in Cider vs Melbourne poopoo
matchup.holding: Santi Aldama (DAL, 4 games next week), Nic Claxton (CHI, 3 games next week).
matchup.plan_md:
**Score 697 to 745, down 48, with 4 days left. As rostered: 1,410 to 1,485.** The owner is happy to drop VanVleet and Gafford, and chose **option B**: claim Jarrett Allen for Gafford, and stream VanVleet's slot.

| Option | Adds | Our lineup, Thu–Sun (script) |
|---|---:|---:|
| A: rotate both slots (*Rotating* section) | 5 | 834 (+120.5 on 713) |
| **B: Allen for Gafford by waiver claim, then rotate VanVleet's slot (*What-if* below)** | 4 | 722 + 87.8 |
| Keep both | 0 | 713 |

Option B gives up about 24 points this week, if Allen plays Friday and Saturday, to end the week holding Allen. That is the 834 against the 722 + 87.8 above. On form Allen beats Gafford over the season: 34.0 (8) against 31.6 (8), a 36.9 projection against 29.3, and 36.9 last season against 28.2 (`council/form.py`).

**Moves:**

| # | Status | Deadline, Melbourne (ET) | Move |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Done** (07:46 UTC Thu 5) | — | Dropped Fred VanVleet, added **Dillon Brooks** (PHX), who plays tonight at home to ORL |
| 2 | **Claim placed** (07:42 UTC Thu 5) | **Processes 7:00 pm Fri 6** (3:00 am ET Fri; 08:00 UTC, ESPN's `waiverProcessDate`) | Waiver claim on **Jarrett Allen** (CLE), dropping Daniel Gafford. Team Nic Kerr dropped Allen at 02:41 UTC Thu 5. A team higher in the waiver order can still claim him first |
| 3 | Fri 6 | **11:00 am Sat 7** (7:00 pm Fri) | Drop Brooks, add **CJ McCollum** (ATL), for Fri and Sat |
| 4 | Sun 8 | **7:30 am Mon 9** (3:30 pm Sun) | Drop McCollum, add **Nic Claxton** (CHI) |

This uses 4 of 5 adds and keeps one for a late scratch.

- **Jarrett Allen is the risk in option B.**
  - On Wednesday at OKC he hurt his right knee in a knee-on-knee collision after 7 minutes and did not return ([CBS Sports/RotoWire, 4 Nov](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/cavaliers-jarrett-allen-doesnt-return-wednesday/)).
  - He has a history of right patellar tendinopathy. A flare last March cost him 10 games, and he was questionable before the opener.
  - The Cavs await "further medical evaluation on Thursday" ([Roundtable via Yahoo, 5 Nov](https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/cavaliers-concerning-jarrett-allen-injury-021638510.html)). No timetable reported; ESPN day-to-day, *ESPN est.* 6 Nov.
  - **Check Cleveland's Thursday update before the claim processes at 7:00 pm Fri 6.** If he is ruled out for Friday and Saturday, the claim gains nothing this week and costs Gafford's Friday and Sunday games. If the news points to a long absence, cancel it and keep Gafford.
  - No source says why Allen was dropped.
- **Dillon Brooks:** 28.0 (6); L7 30.3 (3), L15 28.0 (6), L30 28.0 (6); started 6 of 6.
  - Wednesday against POR: 35 minutes, 15 points, 6 rebounds and 5 fouls. A run-in with Lillard brought no technical or review ([Basketnews, 5 Nov](https://basketnews.com/news-258857-damian-lillard-confronts-dillon-brooks-after-dirty-achilles-contact.html)).
  - Tonight is the second night of a back-to-back. No rest has been reported, but Phoenix had not filed its report.
- **CJ McCollum:** 28.3 (9); L7 28.0 (5), L15 28.3 (9), L30 28.3 (9); started 8 of 9.
  - On Wednesday Kingston Flemings made his first start and moved McCollum to the bench, a role McCollum "reportedly asked for". He still played 25 minutes for 15 points, 5 rebounds and 5 assists ([SI Hawks, 4 Nov](https://www.si.com/nba/hawks/onsi/biggest-takeaways-from-the-atlanta-hawks-impressive-victory-over-the-wizards-01m6mqyxqnne)).
  - Jalen Johnson missed a second game with his left ankle; no timetable reported, *ESPN est.* 6 Nov. Johnson's return would cut McCollum's minutes.
  - Atlanta plays a Fri–Sat back-to-back, with no rest reported.
- **Nic Claxton:** has not played this season (33.3 over 69 games in 2026).
  - He was out again Wednesday. SI says a debut "certainly feels likely" on Sun 8 against PHI ([SI Bulls, 4 Nov](https://www.si.com/nba/bulls/onsi/bulls-at-knicks-6-30-pm-ct-3-ways-to-win-starting-lineups-josh-hart-s-status-4)). No timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 8 Nov.
  - Expect a minutes limit at first. Check Chicago's Sunday report before the move. The fallback is Santi Aldama, if he debuts on Friday.
- **The spare add:** the 4-add row of the *What-if* (+91.8) is only +4.0 over the 3-add chain, and it needs Aldama on Friday. Keep the add for a rest day or a scratch instead.

**Lineups.** Every day from Thursday has open slots, so start everyone with a game.

**Where it leaves us.** With Allen playing and the chain done: about 697 + 722 + 87.8 against 745 + 740, a narrow lead. Swing factors:
- **Trey Murphy III:** out Wednesday with bilateral patellar tendinopathy, his first missed game. No timetable reported for Fri 6 or Sun 8 ([HotTakes, 5 Nov](https://hottakes.com/articles/trey-murphy-iii-sidelined-with-knee-injury-just-as-he-was-saving-the-pel-108b2dcb-4f42-4441-9555-fe104062829d)); *ESPN est.* 6 Nov.
- **Anthony Black:** off Orlando's report for tonight at PHX ([CBS Sports/RotoWire, 4 Nov](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/magics-anthony-black-removed-from-injury-report/)).
- **Dejounte Murray:** back on Wednesday with 45 minutes in overtime, 20 points and 4 steals ([Crescent City Sports, 4 Nov](https://crescentcitysports.com/pelicans-close-strong-dominate-jazz-in-ot-for-4th-straight-win/)).
- **Kawhi Leonard** (IR): finished treatment for the swelling and has begun a return-to-play process. The next update is "in one week", about 10 Nov ([Globe and Mail, 4 Nov](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/sports/hockey/article-raptors-announce-kawhi-leonard-completes-swollen-knee-treatment/)). *ESPN est.* 23 Nov.
- **Jalen Duren:** no update since the 25 Oct plan to re-evaluate him in two weeks, about 8 Nov ([NBC Sports/Rotoworld, 25 Oct](https://www.nbcsports.com/fantasy/basketball/player-news/2026-10-25/duren-hamstring-to-be-re-evaluated-in-two-weeks)). *ESPN est.* 9 Nov. Detroit plays Sun 8.
- **Melbourne poopoo:** none of their players is on an injury report. Klay Thompson, just added, scored 30 at LAC and plays tonight at GS ([ESPN MIA@GS preview, 5 Nov](https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/basketball/nba/summary?event=401909937)). Anthony Edwards is out; *ESPN est.* 21 Dec.
